name: Microsoft Translator
description: A Microsoft Translator which use Microsoft Translator service.
project_description:
Microsoft translator plugin for the Translation Management Tools (TMGMT) project. Allows to submit translation jobs for to Microsoft Translator .

 Features 
 
 Drupal 8 ready 
 Fast and convenient machine translation 
 Supports both deprecated Bing ID's and the new Azure Marketplace token access authentication 
 Basic subscriptions, up to 2 million characters a month, are free 
 
 The project of course also supports implicity all the features which are provided by TMGMT like a feature-rich review process, being able to translate different sources and more.

 Requirements 
 Depends on Translation Management Tools . Registration on https://datamarket.azure.com/developer/applications/ is required to use this module.

 Maintenance 
 Initial development happened during a development sprint organized by Drupal Events in Zurich in January 2012 with more than 20 participants . See http://drupalevents.ch/drupal/codesprint-2012 for more information.

 This is the official integration module for Microsoft Translator, maintained in partnership by MD Systems .
